title: 'I'm going to shoot you': 2 men held at gunpoint before deputies realize their mistake, victims say

reports.title: 'I'm going to shoot you': 2 men held at gunpoint before deputies realize their mistake, victims say

summary:
On Aug. 3 in Cypress, Texas, Harris County sheriff's deputies mistook two 19 year old men, Anthony and Julian, for car thieves. Deputies surrounded Anthony's Camaro with at least five patrol cars and a helicopter, pointed guns, handcuffed them, and one deputy threatened to shoot Julian. Julian had cuts and scrapes after being pushed down. The deputies thought the car was a stolen Camaro linked to aggravated robberies, based on Flock camera alerts, but they could not read the plates and called backup.

After handcuffing the men, deputies realized it was the wrong car and showed them a photo of the stolen vehicle. The men were not charged. Anthony's mother plans to hire an attorney. The sheriff's office says supervisors will review body worn camera footage to check whether procedures were followed. The men were told how to file a formal complaint with internal affairs, and both plan to do so.
title_en: 'I'm going to shoot you': 2 men held at gunpoint before deputies realize their mistake, victims say
